about: The Focusing Orb's tool_animation (focusing_orb.swf, CC0) at 4x: features/meditation-feature.js draws its 40 px cells at ORB_HELD_SIZE 52 px, 1.3 world px per texel, so 3 device px per world px needs 3.9.
